title: Supervisor Distribuição e Frotas – Grupo Bimbo – Rio de Janeiro
description:
Cargo: Supervisor Distribuição e Frotas

Descrição

  • Realizar as observações de segurança diariamente com devido registro na ferramenta disponibilizada pela empresa e fiscalizar as condutas garantindo a aplicação das regras essenciais de segurança.
  • Realizar Diálogo Diário de Desempenho (DDD) junto ao time de motoristas e ajudantes.
  • Garantir início do processo de entregas via aplicação LINCROS ou ferramenta correspondente e acompanhar apontamentos dentro do raio com qualidade.
  • Acompanhamento/Liberação das Rotas/Veículos para entregas do dia.
  • Solicitar e informar ao time de roteirização e monitoramento eventual spot de último momento por falta de motorista.
  • Visitar lojas críticas em rechaço e/ou demais oportunidades a bordo junto com os motoristas com menor performance/oportunidades, preencher link ROTA PERFEITA. Propor planos de melhoria em lojas/redes com alto tempo de retenção, perda de cestos, baixa performance de entregas etc.
  • Acompanhar diariamente e propor melhorias para os principais KPIS da área, como Efetividade de Entrega, Logística Reversa de Cestos, Apontamento dentro do Raio com Qualidade, Controle de Canhotos, Índice de Sinistralidade Viária, Controle de Jornada Laboral e Spots por falta de Motoristas.
  • Informar semanalmente, ou a qualquer alteração no quadro básico de pessoas e/ou de veículos, ao time de roteirização e monitoramento.
  • Acompanhar retorno de rotas ao centro de vendas.
  • Realizar recorrido Diário para assegurar padrão 05s, principalmente nos veículos de distribuição, afim de garantir correto procedimento de cabine e baús limpos e trancados com chave da ignição no claviculário.
  • Acompanhar e atuar sobre Rechaços/Cancelamentos, Notas Fiscais de Devolução e/ou de Remessa de Troca.
  • Participar ativamente dos comitês semanais de cestos e demandas inerentes a controle de equipamentos com foco na redução de perda. Propor e implementar ações de redução de perda. Realizar contagem canal tradicional e enviar as contagens no padrão e no tempo certo ao time de controle de equipamentos.
  • Treinar e garantir aplicação dos processos e procedimentos das funções e dos centros de vendas, monitorar vales e medidas disciplinares ao time de motoristas e ajudantes com as respectivas evidências.
  • Monitorar e tratar semanalmente jornada laboral dos colaboradores com foco em evitar ocorrências.
  • Realizar reunião mensal junto a equipe informando os resultados do mês, reconhecendo os destaques, propondo planos de melhorias, celebrando os resultados e aniversariantes do mês com coffee break.
  • Planejar, Solicitar e Controlar Uniforme, EPI, Celular, material de embarque (corda, gancho e dollie) e material de escritório para uso operacional/administrativo.
  • Coletar assinatura e arquivamento da folha de ponto de todos os colaboradores a cada fechamento de período/mês.
  • Controle de colaboradores através de pastas e folha de serviço, manter em dia a documentação.
  • Validar mensalmente apuração dos KPIS para pagamento de remuneração variável.
  • Enviar semanalmente semana típica a Coordenação.
  • Garantir preenchimento do quadro básico autorizado (tramo x nômina).
  • Reportar imediatamente, conforme modelo oficial padrão divulgado por SAS&B, qualquer acidente de trabalho e/ou viário.
  • Realizar investigação dos acidentes/incidentes com plano de mitigação de riscos e evitar novas ocorrências.
  • Participar ativamente das Reuniões de Comissão de Segurança Viária, garantir a execução dos planos, realizar estações de segurança e revisão sistemática dos veículos.
  • Realizar mensalmente a Matriz de Auto Controle (MAC), reportar a Gestão Imediata e evidenciar na pasta de Controle Nacional.
  • Prestar constas semanal e mensalmente a Coordenação e Gerência da área sobre os KPIS da área.
  • Realizar avaliações de Desempenho, Feedback, Potencial e PDI da equipe sob gestão.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa
  • Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas, Logística ou áreas correlatas
  • Excel intermediário
  • CNH B

  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale-refeição
  • Vale-transporte

Liderar junto ao gestor da auditoria, promovendo evolução dos controles e mitigação de riscos.
Garantir junto ao time a implementação de melhorias nos processos e controles internos, visando excelência operacional.
Gerenciar a divulgação oficial dos resultados, reduzindo prazos e aumentando a eficiência.

Atuar como interface estratégica com o jurídico para contratos.
Liderar a implantação de módulos SAP e o treinamento das áreas requisitantes, promovendo integração e eficiência.

Prescribed Qualification Standards

  • Training: None required
  • Experience: None required
  • Career Service (Professional)/Second Level Eligibility

Preferred Qualification Standards

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree preferably in Engineering, Management, Business/Public Administration or any other related courses
  • Training: Four (4) hours of relevant training
  • Experience: At least one (1) year of relevant experience related to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality, as well as volunteers’ deployment
  • Career Service (Professional)/Second Level Eligibility

Additional Requirements

  • Knowledge on MS Office
  • Great attention to detail
  • Good analytical thinking
  • Knowledge in Inventory Management
  • High level of written and oral communication skills
  • Able to work harmoniously, competently and effectively even under pressure

Job Description

Under general supervision, performs technical and support functions of Logistics Management Division (LMD) and does other related works.

Functions and Responsibilities

  1. Provides technical support to the Production Management Section;
  2. Prepares and submits material requisitions for raw materials, indirect materials and other supplies/materials, non-disposable PPEs, as well as production materials issued to the workforce;
  3. Prepares and sets up mechanized production workstations, prepositions goods/items, and performs inventory taking of raw materials used and identified as damage or defective;
  4. Collects and accounts all supplies/materials, non-disposable PPEs, and other materials issued to workforce including raw materials left in the production area;
  5. Maintains records of inter-warehouse releases/transfers of mechanized FFP production, raw materials, indirect materials; and ensures that records are up to date at all times;
  6. Briefly orients and assists volunteers in the manual production;
  7. Responsible for the daily preparation and submission of reports to the section head;
  8. Ensures the correct implementation of standards/criteria for mechanized production of FFPs as well as other production management section activities such as manual FFP production, rice vacuum packing, rice reconditioning/milling;
  9. Performs other tasks as may be required from time to time.

Job Outputs

  1. Communications and reports related to the functions of the Logistics Management Division and Production Management Section;
  2. Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly and Annual Reports regarding Mechanized FFP Production Output, Material Usage Report, Material Requisitions and Inventories, Rice Vacuum Packing Machine/Milling Machine Performance and others;
  3. Concept Notes and Activity/Project Proposals;
  4. Other Administrative Reports.

  • Training: 10%
  • Experience: 25%
  • IQT: 10%
  • Technical Exam: 15%
  • Interview: 10%
  • Performance Review: 5%

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Você assumirá muitas funções e trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. A função envolve:

  • Estar presencialmente na estação de entrega. Amazon lidera operações 24-7, e portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança em sua área de trabalho.
  • Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.

  • Ficar obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para impulsionar as melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento / implementação de sistemas / processos mais novos e coletar feedback.
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir as operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • As Material Controller, your core responsibility is to manage and maintain the flow of materials required for projects and for the operations. Your role is crucial in ensuring the efficient and effective management of materials and inventory to support uninterrupted project and operations’ execution. This role requires a strong understanding of supply chain management, inventory control, and coordination with multiple departments to support project timelines and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Inventory Management: You maintain and lead accurate counting and records of material in stock. You oversee material handling, storage, and preservation to prevent damage, loss, or deterioration of materials. You ensure that the storage areas are kept clean and organized.
  • Material Movement: You keep records of the in and out stock movements. You initiate, treat and coordinate the demand of transfer and move of material between storage locations. You handle the distribution of materials, supplies, and equipment based on incoming requests and orders.
  • Coordination: You maintain good communication with the yard, the warehouse or cargo teams with regards to equipment that requires additional coordination from them.
  • Documentation: You maintain and lead the maintenance of comprehensive material records, including receipts, issuances, and transfers, and generate/oversee reports for management and audit purposes.
  • Compliance: You ensure adherence to relevant safety, environmental, and industry regulations in all material-related activities.
  • Material Planning: You track material consumption, and you collaborate with Projects, Maintenance and Supply Chain teams to support the material requirement forecast and to develop effective material planning strategies. You support the identification of potential material shortages, bottlenecks, and supply chain risks. You support the implementation of proactive measures to mitigate risks and develop contingency plans to address unexpected challenges.
  • Material Replenishment: If you are involved in the material replenishment process, you initiate the demand and the replenishment tasks. You coordinate replenishment or material transfer processes to avoid shortages and surplus.
  • Inspection and material Quality Control: If you are involved in the material reception process, you verify and lead the verification of the quality and specifications of incoming materials. You conduct and lead inspections and address any discrepancies or non‑compliance issues.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Stock Management, Supply chain, or Logistics Management.

Experience

  • Proven track record in material control or inventory management within the oil and gas industry or a similar sector.
  • Good knowledge of materials used in oil and gas operations, including equipment and spare parts, and industry specific regulations.
  • Understanding of the procurement processes.
  • Strong experience in warehouse management systems and inventory tracking tool. Knowledge of ERP systems and data analysis tools being preferable.
  • Analytical and problem‑solving skills to optimize material usage and reduce waste.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail to maintain accurate records and comply with industry standards.
  • Good communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate.

title: Quality Engineer - Data
description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long‑term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long‑term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer: Data, you will design and execute comprehensive data quality testing strategies for various data‑intensive applications. You will develop a deep understanding of business requirements and design optimized test scenarios to ensure data quality and integrity.

  • Design Testing Strategies: Design and execute comprehensive data quality testing strategies for ETL, Big Data, and data‑intensive applications, including BAO, MDM, and data migrations.
  • Plan Testing Activities: Plan and execute testing activities, estimate work efforts, create test cases, and identify test environment and test data requirements.
  • Execute Test Cases: Utilize manual and automation solutions to execute test cases, report test status, and perform defect creation, triage, and resolution.
  • Analyze Test Outcomes: Analyze test outcomes for continuous improvements using analytical and cognitive techniques and tools.
  • Optimize Test Scenarios: Develop a deep understanding of business requirements and design optimized test scenarios to ensure data quality and integrity.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

This position is for a talented and experienced Data Test Engineer with a strong background in Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC). In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, volume, and accuracy of data across on‑prem and cloud environments. You will validate data migration, transformation, and integration processes using Informatica IDMC, collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure seamless data ingestion from multiple sources—including streaming technologies, cloud platforms, and various data stores—while maintaining the highest standards of data quality and consistency.

Essential Job Functions

  • Perform data validation and transformation testing to verify completeness, consistency, and accuracy between source and target.

Develop and maintain automated data validation frameworks using Python, SQL, and IDMC’s built‑in tools and APIs.

Implement data quality rules and support continuous integration through CI/CD pipelines.

Collaborate with development, operations, and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.

Document test plans, results, and findings in a structured and traceable manner.

Support testing activities related to data migration, profiling, analysis, and transformation.

Manage defect tracking and reporting, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication.

Contribute to process improvements and testing best practices within an Agile environment.

IDMC Coding Experience

Understanding and creating mappings end‑to‑end on IDMC using Filters, Routers, Joiners, JSON with JSON, parsing JSON filters, JSON structures, JSON strings, and the Structure Parser. Some Java experience to write basic code.

Python Code

Reading files, functions to read and process data from various file formats.

Requirements

A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related information technology field from an accredited institution or equivalent work experience.

  • 6+ years of software product development and delivery experience.
  • Strong experience with SQL.
  • Great experience with IDMC tool or related experience.
  • Great experience overseeing the development of data test plans, test scenarios, test cases, execution of test cases, and documentation of test results.
  • Good experience with some Azure Cloud tools: ADF, Pyspark.
  • Experience with Python and libraries like Pandas.
  • Ability to interpret and draw system & architecture diagrams.
  • Familiar with the latest cloud technologies.

description:

Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency. At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

Mindrift is looking for passionate freelance contributors to join the Tendem project ( to help build the future of hybrid agents — where human expertise and AI capabilities work hand in hand. As an AI Agent Assistant, you'll collaborate with large language models (LLMs) that handle repetitive tasks, while you bring the nuance, judgment, and creativity required to deliver high-quality results. In this role, you won't just review what AI produces — you'll work alongside it, shaping and completing outputs so they are accurate, reliable, and ready for real-world application. Your day‑to‑day may range from fact‑checking a scientific claim to curating a dataset, conducting market research, or refining sales leads. This flexible, part‑time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in research, editing, analysis, or related fields who are excited by the possibilities of human‑AI collaboration. Your contributions will directly influence how AI systems learn, evolve, and support industries worldwide.

This is a freelance role for a project, and your typical tasks may include:

  • Your mission - deliver well‑reasoned, accurate, and clearly written outputs backed by credible sources.
  • Conduct thorough web research to verify information and collect supporting evidence.
  • Collaborate with large language models (LLMs) and internal tools, using them as copilots to complete complex tasks.
  • Design and refine prompts to guide AI toward higher‑quality results.
  • Apply best practices for working with LLMs, understanding both their strengths and limitations.
  • Adapt quickly between diverse annotation, research, and analysis tasks while following detailed guidelines.

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You are currently enrolled in or completed a Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in any field.
  • You have professional and/or educational experience in data annotation, demonstrate a deeper‑than‑user‑level interest in AI, and possess intellectual breadth and curiosity.

What will you be doing?

The Sales Operations Specialist is responsible for ensuring the sales organization operates with speed, accuracy, visibility, and accountability. This role owns the day‑to‑day execution and optimization of the sales tech stack—primarily "HubSpot"—so that Membership Directors (MDs), Setters, and Sales Leadership can focus on selling, not admin. This is a hands‑on, systems‑focused role, not a people manager. You will work closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Data to maintain clean pipelines, automate workflows, enforce process discipline, and deliver reliable reporting. At Decentralized Masters, Sales Ops is mission‑critical. This role directly impacts close rates, cash collection, forecasting accuracy, and the overall scalability of the revenue engine.

Key Responsibilities

CRM Ownership & Sales Systems

  • Own accuracy of HubSpot CRM configuration: pipelines, deal stages, properties, workflows, and permissions
  • Ensure every lead, deal, and contact has correct lead status, lifecycle stages, ownership, and next steps

  • Enforce CRM usage standards across Setters and MDs

Sales Automation & Workflow Management

  • Build and maintain automation for:
    • Lead routing and assignment
    • Task creation and follow‑ups
    • Deal stage progression
    • Call outcomes and disposition tracking
  • Reduce manual admin work for sales reps wherever possible
  • QA all automations to ensure reliability and compliance

Pipeline, Forecasting & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate, real‑time visibility into:
    • Pipeline value and velocity
    • Close rates and conversion metrics
    • DPL (Deals Per Lead), APS, and other core KPIs
  • Build and maintain sales dashboards for leadership
  • Support forecasting and revenue reporting in collaboration with Finance and Data teams

Sales Tools & Integration

  • Manage and support integrations between HubSpot and:
    • Dialers (e.g., "Aloware")
    • Calendars and scheduling tools
    • Payment platforms (e.g., "Whop")
    • Analytics and BI tools
  • Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate fixes with internal tech or third‑party vendors

Process Enforcement & Enablement

  • Translate sales process changes into CRM logic and automation
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to ensure systems reinforce desired behaviors
  • Create and maintain SOPs for sales roles, systems and workflows
  • Act as the point person for Sales Ops requests, improvements, and bug fixes
  • Support and respond to Sales Ops requests submitted via Slack channels

Compliance & Data Integrity

  • Partner with Security/IT on access control and data governance

Required Experience

  • 2-5+ years in Sales Operations, RevOps, or CRM Administration
  • Hands‑on experience with "HubSpot" or similar CRM (required)
  • Mid‑Senior level Sales Operations experience

  • Clear communicator who can translate business needs into system logic

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Familiarity with "Whop", "Aloware", or BI tools
  • Exposure to compliance‑heavy industries (finance, education, crypto, etc.)

What We Offer

Descrição da vaga

A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.

Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

Ser diverso é ser Super!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Objetivo do Cargo:

Atuar na coordenação de projetos estratégicos, com exposição à liderança executiva local e Holding. Este profissional será responsável pela elaboração, monitoramento e reporte de estudos de viabilidade econômica-financeira de projetos estratégicos para suportar a tomada de decisão da alta liderança.

Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais hands‑on, com capacidade analítica e ceticismo profissional, que buscam desafios em um ambiente dinâmico, transformacional e orientado a resultados.

Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir estudos de viabilidade econômica-financeira para iniciativas estratégicas, por meio de métricas de avaliação, tais como: fluxo de caixa descontado, TIR, payback, ROCE e cenários de sensibilidade.

  • Monitorar, analisar e reportar o desempenho econômico‑financeiro das iniciativas estratégicas e investimento em projetos específicos, com base na análise das variações entre Forecast x Planejado, bem como assegurar a aderência às políticas e normas de investimento da Holding.
  • Elaborar e revisar as taxas de desconto para fins de valuation, tais como: WACC e Cost of Equity.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards executivos, bem como apresentações para reuniões de diretoria e comitês local e Holding.
  • Automatizar e otimizar processos da área por meio de ferramentas, tais como: Power BI e recursos de inteligência artificial (IA).

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia Produção e Contabilidade.
  • Vasta experiência em FP&A, investimentos, estratégia, projetos, M&A ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência em projetos multidisciplinares, envolvendo diferentes áreas e stakeholders.
  • Experiência em modelagem financeira avançada, valuation, análises de sensibilidade e projeções.
  • Domínio de metodologias de análise de investimentos (TIR, payback, ROCE, FCD).
  • Excel avançado, com capacidade de construir modelos dinâmicos e cenários.

  • Inglês avançado, com capacidade de leitura, escrita e comunicação.

description:
Based in Montevideo, the two-year Development Graduate Programme offers, 3 × 8 month rotations, across Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance in Energy or Metals and Minerals.

Throughout the programme, graduates gain practical experience and exposure to the full trade lifecycle, working at the core of our operations. By building expertise across these critical functions, graduates develop a strong foundation for success in high-impact middle office roles in Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance and are well‑positioned to grow into future leadership positions.

Guided by some of the most experienced professionals in the industry, graduates receive ongoing support and development opportunities, providing them with the skills, mindset and confidence to help shape the next chapter of our business.

Deals Desk

Deals Desk is responsible for accurate mark‑to‑market valuation, daily P&L and risk and exposure reporting. Deals Desk is an independent control function that works closely with commercial, middle and back‑office teams to ensure timely trade capture and effective management of trading positions in our trading and risk management systems.

Responsibilities include
  • Reviewing and verifying trades and trade terms
  • Producing daily P&L and exposure reports
  • Liaising with traders, operations and finance to reconcile positions
  • Investigating and resolving trade discrepancies

Operations

Operations coordinates the physical movement and delivery of commodities, ensuring contracts are executed efficiently and profitably.

Responsibilities include
  • Managing vessel or land logistics and documentation
  • Liaising with counter parties and terminal
  • Tracking cargo movements and inventories
  • Ensuring compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements

Trade Finance

Trade Finance designs and implements the financing solutions that enable the physical movement of commodities, while managing credit and performance risks.

Responsibilities include
  • Structuring and executing real‑world commodity trade finance deals
  • Drafting, negotiating and managing trade documents such as letters of credit, guarantees and receivables financing
  • Monitoring global trade flows, payment schedules and risk exposure across complex transactions
  • Collaborating with traders, operations, credit teams and banking partners to resolve day‑to‑day financing and logistics challenges

Knowledge Skills And Abilities

  • 0-2 years of postgraduate working experience
  • Fluency in English and Spanish - both oral and written
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • High degree of intellectual curiosity, passion, motivation and grit
  • Ability to remove roadblocks and break down barriers to get the job done
  • Passion for working in a collaborative, challenging and dynamic environment
  • A global, innovative mindset

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Nosso propósito é amar resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Safety Advisor to join the Saudi Aramco Loss Prevention organization (LP).

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary role is to provide daily support to company facilities and departments, helping them effectively implement the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System expectations and associated programs, as well as assuring compliance to all company safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Facilitate implementation of the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System, as well as its objectives and expectations, including developing associated safety processes, and participating in self-assessments.
  • Conduct field inspections/reviews to assess compliance to company and international codes and standards, identify safety concerns, formulate solutions, and develop practical and cost-effective corrective actions.
  • Identify, evaluate, recommend actions, and follow up on critical, yet universal safety tasks and control methodologies related to operational safety practices (e.g., work at height, isolation/LOTO, permit to work, hydrogen sulfide, confined space entry, excavations).
  • Participate in safety studies/activities using risk assessment and mitigation methodologies, such as: PHAs, HAZOPs, JSAs, incident investigations, compliance reviews, or insurance surveys.
  • Respond to emergency situations and incidents, either during or after regular working hours, to provide technical assistance and advice.
  • Participate in worksite contractor safety management activities (e.g., contractor selection and prequalification, monitoring of work site compliance, and measurement of performance).
  • Support the reporting, classification and investigation all incidents, and participating in incident investigations, determination of root causes, and proper recommendations to prevent recurrence.
  • Deliver Loss Prevention-specific training to employees, contractors, and outside parties.
  • Mentor other LP personnel.
  • You will hold a Bachelor of Science degree from an Accredited Institution and seven years of experience areas in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, such as: operations and maintenance, plant engineering, construction, turnaround and inspection, safety program development, process safety, and audits/assessments.
  • Or you will have 15 years of relevant industry experience in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, including a strong track record in delivering results, as referenced above, without a degree.
  • You will also have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Aqui você pode ser quem você é. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas!

  • Supervisionar, acompanhar, orientar e distribuir as atividades da área de manutenção elétrica e predial da unidade;

  • Elaborar e revisar os procedimentos operacionais relativos às operação dos componentes elétricos como disjuntores, seccionadores, transformadores, etc em conformidade com as normas NR-10 e segurança do trabalho
  • Treinar funcionários através dos POP’s e manuais técnicos dos equipamentos, de modo a garantir seu correto funcionamento e aderência às normas estabelecidas pela NR-10 e segurança do trabalho;
  • Prover informações para a tomada de decisões por parte da gerência industrial, fornecendo informações, sugestões e subsídios;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento por parte dos colaboradores sob sua gestão, de normas administrativas e políticas definidas pela alta gestão da empresa;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas de GMP, de Qualidade, Meio Ambiente, e Segurança do Trabalho visando atender às exigências e consequentemente aos indicadores de qualidade esperados;
  • NR 10 – Segurança em instalações e serviços em eletricidade;
  • SEP – Sistemas Elétricos de Potência;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em eletrotécnica, interpretação e análise de diagramas elétricos e comandos, análise defalhas em circuitos elétricos, operação de instrumentos de medição elétrica (osciloscópio, multímetro, medidores de potência, etc), inversores de frequência, CLP’s, IHM’s.
  • Informática á nível de usuário (Microsoft Office).

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Sr. Director of IT for Auxiliary Enterprises, the IT Support Specialist is responsible for providing general IT support across all Auxiliary Enterprises. IT-related tasks may include setting up, managing, and troubleshooting technology systems used by each business unit associated with the Office of Auxiliary Enterprises. Duties may include providing end-user support with laptop and desktop computers; providing support for card readers, printers or other IT and computer peripherals; assistance with Howard University physical and Wi-Fi network; diagnosing and resolving hardware problems including specialized hardware such as point-of-sale terminals, building controllers, laundry machine interface devices, OR parking ticket issuing hand-held terminals; configuring and updating system and application software; and tracking down data and communication issues.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provides technical support for various hardware used across Auxiliary Enterprises including point-of-sale terminals, printers, laptops, desktop computers, cameras, card readers, scanners, contactless readers, monitors, kitchen-display systems, time clocks, building/laundry controllers, building/laundry readers, point-of-sale terminals, peripherals, and other equipment used by contractors and employees in Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Provide Tier-1 support for Dining Service point-of-sale terminals and peripherals.
  • Level Review diagnostics and assess the functionality and efficiency of systems.
  • Work with system providers in the support of various applications.
  • Work with Howard University ETS to implement, enforce and support security measures.
  • Monitor security certificates and company compliance with requirements.
  • Monitor systems to ensure they are operating as expected.
  • Provide technical support to Auxiliary Enterprises contract staff and troubleshoot computer systems and peripheral equipment used by Auxiliary Enterprises contractors.
  • Install and update company software and hardware as needed.
  • Anticipate and make recommendations regarding the replacement or updating of computer items.
  • Assist with installation, upgrades, and the disposal of IT-related products.
  • Coordinate with ETS and off-prem/cloud-based vendors to ensure that Auxiliary Enterprises systems and data are backed up and backups are verified and able to be restored when necessary.
  • Assemble, install, and configure systems and components per vendor specifications BUT within the policies, procedures, and best practices of Howard University, HU Enterprise Technology Services, and Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Stay updated regarding the knowledge and skills needed to keep up with rapid advancements in computer technology.
  • Maintains logs of activities and completed work and provides reports to the Sr. Director. Specifically, Laundry System Status and the Auxiliary Enterprises IT Asset List. Additional logs may be assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of TCP/IP, networking, and related technologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft Windows Operating system.
  • Ability to develop plans for resolving and implementing technical and operational problems.
  • Ability to work independently, to plan and prioritize activities that may span several locations on campus.
  • Ability to identify and resolve technical problems due to complex system interfaces.
  • Competence in both oral and written English to communicate clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to operate in an office environment and in the field (various locations across all campuses of Howard University).
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the community.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or closely related field and one year relevant experience; or equivalent combination of a total of five (5) years combined relevant education and experience.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Lead Payroll Analyst
description:
Overview

Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us! The benefits information above is provided for guidance.

Job Purpose

Job Purpose

The Lead Payroll Analyst plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and effective operation of Howard University’s payroll processes. This position supports the review and validation of payroll data, monitors payroll activity for consistency, and assists in the timely processing of bi-weekly and off-cycle compensation for faculty, staff, and student workers. The Lead Payroll Analyst also serves as a primary resource for employee payroll inquiries, offering guidance and facilitating timely resolution with a strong customer service focus. The role helps maintain internal controls and supports cross-departmental collaboration to ensure payroll is administered in alignment with University policies, collective bargaining agreements, and applicable federal and state regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature And Scope

Nature And Scope

The Lead Payroll Analyst functions as an experienced payroll professional within the University’s centralized payroll structure and supports the accurate and timely execution of bi-weekly payrolls and supplemental off-cycle payments. The role requires close coordination with Human Resources, Budget, Benefits, Accounting, and departmental administrators to verify payroll data, ensure proper documentation, and support consistent payroll operations across the institution. This position interacts frequently with employees, supervisors, and campus partners to address payroll questions and provide guidance on payroll-related matters. The Lead Payroll Analyst must apply strong analytical skills, confidentiality, and sound judgment when evaluating payroll information or resolving issues. The role contributes to audit preparedness, supports payroll reconciliations, and assists with recurring quarterly and annual payroll reporting activities.

Principal Accountabilities

Principal Accountabilities

Payroll Preparation & Support

  • Prepare and validate payroll inputs in advance of each payroll cycle, ensuring HR-provided files (salaries, benefits, job changes) are complete and properly formatted for processing.
  • Perform pre-payroll audits to identify missing data, unexpected variances, incorrect deductions, or tax issues, and escalate findings to the Payroll Manager.
  • Support the Director/Manager during monthly payroll processing by running calculations, reviewing results, and resolving flagged errors.
  • Process routine off-cycle items such as corrections, small retro payments, and adjustments as directed by the Payroll Manager.

Employee Support & Inquiry Management

  • Manage the Payroll Inbox by monitoring, prioritizing, and responding to employee payroll questions related to pay, taxes, deductions, direct deposit, and time reporting.
  • Research and resolve routine issues; escalate complex or policy-impacting matters to the Payroll Manager.
  • Track common inquiry themes and recommend updates to FAQs or procedure guides.

Garnishments, Deductions & Payments

  • Process wage garnishments, tax levies, child support orders, and other wage attachments; maintain records and prepare remittance packets for manager approval.
  • Administer union dues, voluntary deductions, and retirement contributions that originate within Payroll’s purview (not HR-managed benefits).
  • Maintain logs of all remittances and assist in preparing reconciliations for manager review.

System Support (Workday & ADP)

  • Update and maintain basic Workday Payroll configuration items (simple deductions, tax updates, pay schedule updates) under guidance from the Payroll Manager.
  • Execute routine tests during Workday releases and patches; document issues and assist with troubleshooting.
  • Assist with ADP Tax Services interactions, including reviewing tax files, setting up new jurisdictions, and documenting tax notices for management action.

Reconciliation, Reporting & Compliance Support

  • Prepare standard payroll reports (registers, deduction reports, tax summaries) for manager review before final processing.
  • Assist with monthly reconciliations of payroll liabilities, verifying balances and following up on discrepancies with Accounting.
  • Support quarterly and year-end processes by gathering data, running preliminary reports, and assisting with W-2 review.
  • Maintain organized documentation for internal and external audit requests.

Process Improvement & Team Support

  • Document payroll procedures, update job aids, and maintain checklists to ensure consistency and accuracy in recurring tasks.
  • Recommend process improvements to reduce errors or improve efficiency.
  • Provide cross-training support to payroll staff and serve as backup on routine tasks when needed.

Core Competencies

Core Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of payroll regulations, wage attachments, and taxation, with experience supporting complex higher-education payroll environments.
  • Proficiency in Workday Payroll and familiarity with ADP SmartCompliance, including basic configuration, troubleshooting, and report execution.
  • Advanced attention to detail and analytical skills, with the ability to audit data, identify discrepancies, and support reconciliations.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain payroll concepts clearly and provide high-quality customer service.
  • Strong Excel capability (pivot tables, lookups, data validation) for payroll auditing and analysis.
  • Proven ability to maintain confidentiality, follow internal controls, and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.
  • Collaborative team player who works well with HR, Accounting, Benefits, and campus departments to resolve issues and support payroll operations.
  • Adaptable and proactive, with a continuous improvement mindset and willingness to learn new systems and processes.

Minimum Requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.
  • 3–5 years of payroll experience in a complex, multi-department organization; higher education experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of payroll regulations, multi-state taxation, wage garnishments, and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Experience using Workday Payroll or another enterprise-level payroll system; familiarity with ADP SmartCompliance is a plus.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and data validation.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to identify discrepancies and support reconciliations.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information in accordance with university policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills for responding to employee inquiries and supporting campus partners.

title: Manager, Volunteer System
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Events & Entertainment

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train-the-Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community-building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Consolidar e analisar os dados provenientes das inspeções de segurança realizadas nas diversas unidades e frentes de trabalho, identificando padrões de desvios, riscos críticos recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria, bem como apoiar o acompanhamento dos planos de ação decorrentes dessas inspeções, avaliando sua aderência e efetividade.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Estamos buscando para atuação em Macaé um Engenheiro de Reparos e Rotativos para a assegurar manutenções preventivas e corretivas de equipamentos e componentes em instalações terrestres, buscando segurança, confiabilidade qualidade, prazo e custo.

#LI-TR1

#LI-ONSITE

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerenciar ordem de serviço de equipamentos no CMMS;
  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver fornecedores para execução do escopo técnico de serviço;
  • Delinear a execução do serviço de manutenção;
  • Diligenciar todo processo logístico desde a base de recebimento até o fornecedor e o retorno de equipamento, considerando os requisitos técnicos do transporte;
  • Emitir requisição de compras de materiais e serviços aplicados na manutenção;
  • Acompanhar os pedidos de compras relativos aos reparos e sobressalentes;
  • Acompanhar tecnicamente o serviço de reparo e garantir o controle de qualidade, custo e prazo de entrega;
  • Realizar visitas periódicas nos fornecedores para acompanhamentos dos reparos críticos e emergenciais;
  • Reportar semanalmente o andamento dos reparos para os stakeholders;
  • Analisar e aprovar documentação técnica relativa à manutenção.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico);

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia: Mecânica; Naval; Produção ou outras relacionadas;

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória;

  • Conhecimento pleno de planejamento e controle da manutenção;
  • Conhecimento técnico em equipamentos rotativos de produção tais como turbogeradores, compressores centrífugos, compressores de recuperação, motores diesel, bombas, etc;
  • Conhecimento técnico pleno em processos de reparo tais como desmontagem/montagem, engenharia de materiais, padrões construtivos de equipamentos, ensaios não destrutivos, solda, usinagem, tratamento térmico, teste estanqueidade, teste de performance, etc;
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos;
  • Conhecimento pleno em investigação de falhas e em orçamentação e gestão de custos de reparo;
  • Conhecimento pleno em normas de segurança e requisitos regulatórios.

Qualificações/certificações:

  • Conhecimento de SAP módulo PS, PM e MM;
  • Conhecimento pleno dos pacotes Windows e Office;
  • Inglês Intermediário

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A idéia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A idéia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

About the Company

Our client is a China-based IoT and telecommunications solutions provider with a global footprint. The company designs, manufactures and operates connectivity solutions including cellular modules, IoT devices, and messaging platforms, working closely with telecom operators worldwide to enable SMS A2P, Voice and IoT connectivity.

As part of its expansion in LATAM, the company is creating its first commercial role in Brazil, focused on building and strengthening relationships with local telecom operators.

This is a commercial, operator-facing role, focused on wholesale telecom and carrier relationships. The position is not technical and not end-customer sales.

Nice to Have

Why Join

  • Newly created role with high visibility and growth potential
  • Opportunity to work in a global, international environment
  • Direct exposure to telecom operators and international markets
  • Be part of the LATAM expansion of a global telecom and IoT player

title: NUTRICIONISTA - CEDTEA - AP 3.3
description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar Avaliação e Diagnóstico Nutricional Especializado
  • Realizar o diagnóstico nutricional para identificar carências nutricionais, alergias ou intolerâncias, comuns em pessoas com TEA.
  • Participar de reuniões de equipe e discussões de caso com profissionais da equipe multiprofissional;
  • Implementar estratégias para lidar com a seletividade alimentar severa e recusa alimentar, utilizando técnicas de aproximação gradativa dos alimentos.
  • Desenvolver plano alimentar individualizado baseado em evidências científicas, focando em nutrientes importantes para o desenvolvimento.
  • Abordar comportamentos repetitivos ou restrições alimentares, visando a melhoria da nutrição sem causar desconforto ou ansiedade.
  • Capacitar pais, familiares e cuidadores sobre as necessidades alimentares e como promover práticas alimentares saudáveis.
  • Utilizar abordagens para implementação da terapia alimentar
  • Implementar protocolos como o Food Chaining (Cadeia Alimentar) para introduzir novos alimentos de forma gradual, respeitando o limite sensorial do paciente.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional a dessensibilização para que o usuário consiga tolerar, tocar, cheirar e, finalmente, provar novos alimentos.
  • Realizar oficinas culinárias ou grupos de apoio para ensinar formas criativas de preparar alimentos que o paciente costuma recusar
  • Monitorar deficiências de micronutrientes comuns em dietas restritivas e prescrever suplementação quando necessário.
  • Participar de reuniões com equipe multiprofissional para alinhar as estratégias de reforço positivo e manejo comportamental durante as refeições.
  • Realizar atendimentos e visitas domiciliares compartilhados com outros profissionais da equipe multiprofissional.
  • Garantir a qualidade do registro das atividades nos sistemas nacionais de informação da Atenção Especializada.

Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Nutrição;
  • Especialização completana área ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Nutricionista.

Horário de Trabalho

20h semanais

Etapas de Seleção

  • Step 4: Entrevista Técnica e por Competências 4 Entrevista Técnica e por Competências

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.

  • Mentor others: guide mid‑level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post‑mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event‑driven architectures.

  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client‑facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi‑cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

The Project Coordinator for ETS coordinates and functions of a designated project to ensure that goals and objectives specified for the project are accomplished in accordance with established priorities, time limitations, funding limitations or other specifications. Supervisory Authority

Has responsibility or authority which is limited to the direction of student or temporary workers.

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff and students both within the department and University-wide. External contacts include government agencies, sponsor representatives, vendors, visitors, officials and the general public.

  • Develop, compile and write communications and promotional literature for distribution such as newsletters, brochures or flyers; coordinates process from development through printing and distribution.

Core Competencies

title: Security Investigator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Security Investigator to join our Corporate Security Department (CSD).

CSD is responsible for providing highly specialized professional, investigative and consulting services to Saudi Aramco’s Corporate and Executive Management, in order to safeguard the Company and its communities.

Your primary role is to conduct Company based investigations, in respect of serious and complex issues, including, but not limited to fraud, business ethics, abuse of authority, conflict of interest, misuse of resources, harassment, crimes against the person, anti-social behavior, unsafe acts, cybersecurity and data leakage.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

  • Conduct and lead highly complex and sensitive misconduct investigations, in accordance with legal norms, with specific reference to and compliance with Saudi Labor Law and relevant Company Policies and Procedures.
  • Initiate, administer and plan investigations, and present the case findings to internal control organizations.
  • Provide regular briefings supported by detailed, evidential reports and information to Corporate and Executive Management, in addition to line management.
  • Perform interviews to identify and develop facts to resolve investigative issues and expediently prepare high quality, well-structured and evidential professional reports of investigation.
  • Identify, prevent and detect wrongdoing or offending
  • Provide misconduct and cybersecurity awareness programs throughout the Company.
  • Identify cost savings, reimbursements and recoveries in favor of Saudi Aramco arising from investigative findings and recommend relevant business change practices and lessons learned to mitigate and negate current and future risks.
  • Conduct detailed research (from open and closed sources) and crime pattern/risk analysis, to identify trends, hot spots, actual or potential corporate threats and vulnerabilities.
  • Maintain and organize investigation case files to a high quality and auditable standard in compliance with data protection norms.
  • Liaise with Company stakeholders and external parties as required, in progressing and reviewing investigative outcomes and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Coach and develop junior investigators and keep abreast of investigative techniques and legal norms.
  • You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Criminology, Police Sciences or Security Studies. Degrees in the following disciplines are also acceptable: Business and Management, Computer & Information Systems, and Police Administration.
  • You will have nine (9) years of experience in law enforcement and/or corporate investigations with a proven ability in conducting complex cases of investigation, in respect of fraud, business ethics, abuse of authority, conflict of interest, misuse of resources, harassment, crimes against the person, anti-social behavior, unsafe acts, cybersecurity and data leakage etc.
  • You will be able to demonstrate excellent organizational, analytical and evidential skills, when conducting investigations and presenting relevant findings.
  • You must have excellent report writing skills and the ability to structure and summarize case findings in a concise, logical and articulate manner in compliance with legal norms.
  • You will be able to build effective work relationships in a diverse and multi-cultural environment is a necessity.
  • You will have a recognized professional certification, in related disciplines, such as a Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Professional Certified Investigator (PCI), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), International Compliance Association (ICA), Certified Forensic Interviewer (CFI) or equivalent.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.
